ratio: The Supreme Court noted intimidation by members of the Barabanki bar created such fear that accused were denied access to lawyers, bail remedies and a fair trial in Uttar Pradesh.

title: Court Cannot Quash Forgery FIR Before Handwriting Expert’s Report Comes: Supreme Court
ratio: The Supreme Court said when an FIR contains specific allegations of forgery and disputed documents are being examined by handwriting experts, the high court should not quash the case before the expert report is received.
